decision_basis: The pinned source exposes reversible ID maps and untruncated full item-score vectors, so an adapter can export identity-preserving scores before source top-k. Readiness is blocked by missing data/environment/config bindings, the absence of a TEST-sealed training/validation orchestration, incomplete catalog/ID parity, and conflicts between source and v5 split, truth, tie, and GAUC semantics.

source_interfaces.adapter_use: Invoke without changing pairwise BPR mathematics or negative-sampling policy.
Freeze and hash raw user/product token to internal ID maps; preserve [PAD]=0 as an excluded sentinel.
Export every internal item score for selected users before torch.topk, masking, or reranking.
Use only as a semantic reference and official-source seam; do not reuse its top-k output for harmonized v5.

conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: configured USER_ID_FIELD token remapped by Dataset
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Preserve the exact raw token and internal ID bidirectionally; user 0 exclusion belongs to the v5 preparation/evaluator contract, not an inferred source rule.

conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: configured ITEM_ID_FIELD token remapped by Dataset
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Bind every catalog product to one internal item ID, exclude only [PAD] internal ID 0, and preserve raw_product_id for deterministic tie resolution.

conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: atomic .inter row consumed by Dataset and pairwise TrainDataLoader
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Materialize only the preregistered v5 training-positive event class. The exact snapshot field name is not present in the frozen inputs and is not invented here.

conceptual_field_mapping.v5_concept: event time and temporal split membership
conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: configured TIME_FIELD plus externally prepared split membership
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Use frozen v5 boundaries and split-index hashes. Do not invoke the random RO/RS default and do not let source preprocessing derive split identity.

conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: standalone evaluator truth set keyed by raw user/product IDs
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Subtract all historical seen products before evaluation and exclude users with no novel organic purchase; do not rely on source used-minus-positive semantics for repeated targets.

conceptual_field_mapping.v5_concept: full 5200-product candidate universe including cold products
conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: full score export joined to the frozen catalog ID map
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Reject if any product is absent, duplicated, unknown, or silently zero-filled. A catalog-only item may enter the model identity space only through a frozen, source-supported item mapping with parity evidence.

conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: standalone evaluator mask over full score artifact
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Mask all v5 history products to -inf using frozen history hashes before ranking.
Sort by score descending and then raw_product_id ascending; source torch.topk output is not accepted.

conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: standalone evaluator over v5 candidates and truth
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Source formulae are compatible in form, but only the shared evaluator may establish v5 denominators, masks, eligibility, ties, and per-user vectors.

conceptual_field_mapping.source_interface: standalone evaluator exact unseen-positive versus unseen-negative AUC
conceptual_field_mapping.rule: Use average ranks for score ties and an unweighted mean over eligible users; never import source positive-count-weighted GAUC.

allowed: Read an immutable, already-produced full score artifact and its exact source run manifest.
Map internal RecBole user/item IDs back to frozen raw IDs with total coverage checks.
Remove the [PAD] sentinel by identity, not by score.
Normalize schema and numeric serialization without changing values or score direction.
Emit count/hash/schema manifests and pass full scores to the separately frozen v5 evaluator.
forbidden: Change BPR embeddings, loss, optimizer, negative sampling, checkpoint, or scoring function.
Use run_hyper.py or objective_function for project tuning.
Load project v5 TEST during dataset remapping, training, tuning, validation, or adapter parity.
Use RecBole torch.topk ordering as the v5 tie policy.
Relabel positive-count-weighted RecBole GAUC as v5 macro GAUC.
Drop unknown users/items, omit cold products, impute missing scores, convert missing values to zero, calibrate, rerank, or truncate before export.

source_runner_preconditions.requirement: A project-owned train/validation orchestration must be frozen that does not invoke quick-start's automatic TEST evaluation and cannot resolve any TEST path before authorization.
source_runner_preconditions.reason: run_recbole and objective_function construct and evaluate test_data; objective_function reports it to tuning.

source_runner_preconditions.requirement: Prepared v5 split membership, raw ID maps, and the 5,200-product catalog must be immutable inputs with hashes before source dataset construction.
source_runner_preconditions.reason: Source default global preprocessing and random split are not the v5 protocol.

source_runner_preconditions.requirement: The exact runtime lock, literal argv/config, seed, negative sampler, checkpoint rule, and resource envelope must be frozen before execution.
source_runner_preconditions.reason: Source declarations are ranges and documentation does not bind a producing configuration.

source_runner_preconditions.requirement: Official-source reproduction and harmonized v5 validation must use separate namespaces, tables, and receipts.
source_runner_preconditions.reason: The source random-split evaluator and v5 temporal standalone evaluator are different estimands.

required_parity_fixtures.must_prove: Every exported user/product ID round-trips exactly and [PAD] alone is excluded.
Exactly 5,200 unique v5 products, including the 250 cold products, have one score per evaluated user.
Adapter output preserves every source score bit/value, order-independent identity join, row count, and no missingness imputation.
All historical products are masked and a repeated target is excluded from novel truth rather than unmasked as a source positive.
Top-k order is score descending then raw_product_id ascending independently of internal ID and Torch behavior.
HR@10 and binary NDCG@10 match manually computed values for single and multiple truths and only eligible users enter the mean.
v5 GAUC uses average score-tie ranks and an unweighted user mean, with a case where positive-count weighting would differ.
Training, tuning, validation, score export, and parity fail closed if any project TEST path or hash is requested before the later TEST gate.
Declared adapter/evaluator inputs and outputs equal the physical file sets and every byte hash replays.

official_source_seam.required_before_rerun: Freeze provider lineage, exact environment, literal argv/resolved config, seeds/aggregation, source evaluator identity, target policy, tolerance, and receipts without using output to choose them.
